title: Mental observables show interference of probabilities

statements.text: Quantum-like behavior of cognition shows as interference of probabilities for mental observables, measured by a nonzero coefficient of interference that can be found from statistical data, and the model predicts hyperbolic as well as trigonometric interference.
statements.falsification_criteria: A zero interference coefficient in the data from the proposed recognition experiments.

sources.quote: Cognitive QL-behavior is characterized by a nonzero coefficient of interference
